ben-ops: Heads-up: eu-west-2 (eu2) experienced a sustained GPU node eviction wave starting ~03:12 UTC. Evictions correlate with flapping egress routes from a single upstream peer. We lost ~30-45% capacity in the G4 pool and had to shift ~40% of traffic to us-east and open reserved burst capacity. Noticing runbook gaps related to egress-induced evictions — need follow-ups.

maya-sre: Thanks. Confirmed evictions line up with netlink resets. We cordoned and forced-drained 6 nodes. Kernel logs: `kernel: netlink: nlmsg overflow` repeated.

oliver-eng: Any cost impact? Reserved burst usage added ~+12% ops spend for the incident window (rough estimate).

linda-product: User impact check — embeddings and heavy-gen routes saw elevated latency and some 5xxs for ~12m. A few customers hit higher tail latency.

ben-ops: Impact timeline we observed: 03:12-03:24 partial degradation, 03:24-04:40 traffic reroute + burst allocation, ~04:40 normal routing resumed.

infra-bot: reserved-pool-burst allocated 12 GPUs at 03:28 UTC (triggered by ben-ops).

maya-sre: Proposed action items (quick):
1) Add egress-flap -> gpu-eviction correlation checks to the runbook and monitoring.
2) Add an immediate checklist: open reserved pool, tag and rate-limit heavy gen routes, advertise fallback model.
3) Add a diagnostic step to check kernel netlink error patterns and recommend rtnl timeout tuning.
4) Document traffic-shift thresholds (percentages) and cooldown windows for weighted routing shifts.

oliver-eng: +1. Also suggest a pre-warm warm-pool step when egress instability is detected (auto-trigger 10% pre-warm).

ben-ops: I'll draft the runbook PR. Draft snippet to add: 
```
# if >20% GPU evictions within 10m
- cordon and drain noisy nodes
- allocate reserved-burst capacity and confirm allocation
- shift traffic with weighted routing (example: 60/40 -> healthy region)
- tag requests with fallback model and reduce batch sizes
- notify oncall and escalate to infra lead if >30m
```

linda-product: Please include a customer communication template for degraded generation routes and expected ETA to recovery.

maya-sre: I'll own the monitoring/tests for the new netlink error grep and eviction thresholds, and add alerts to pagers.

oliver-eng: I'll run a traffic-shift dry run during the next maintenance window and document any behavioral quirks.

ben-ops: Assigning owners: maya -> monitoring + tests, oliver -> dry-run + validation, ben -> runbook PR, linda -> comms template. Target: PR + test plan by EOD tomorrow.

maya-sre: Added TODOs in the runbook tracker: https://go/infra-runbook/eviction-egress (internal link).

ben-ops: Thanks all. We'll convert this into a short postmortem in #postmortems once runbook PR is merged. :white_check_mark:
